item.title: Mamdani Promised a New Era for Parks and Libraries. His First Budget Falls Short.
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani rode into office on a wave of progressive promises, including pledges to boost funding for parks and public libraries. item.title: Mamdani Moves to End Rikers Emergency Orders, Implement Solitary Reforms
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani released a plan Thursday to end nearly five years of emergency orders that have suspended basic jail rules at Rikers Island. item.description: A Manhattan appeals court on Thursday put on hold one of NYCHA’s most ambitious and controversial projects, its plan to demolish and replace 2,000 units of public housing in the Fulton and Elliott-Chelsea Houses. item.title: HUD Rule Change Targets Mixed-Immigration Status Families
item.description: The Department of Housing and Urban Development is proposing a rule that would make it much harder for families with mixed immigration status to receive federal housing assistance.
